sloka: विचेतनम् विघूर्णन्तम् शीतेषु बल पीडितम् ।निरस्तम् दृश्य मारीचम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-३०-१९॥
transliteration: vicetanam vighūrṇantam śīteṣu bala pīḍitam ।nirastam dṛśya mārīcam rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt ॥1-30-19॥

translations.english: "O Lakshmana behold this Manavaastra associated with righteousness employing a cool arrow, which carries him away by making him unconscious and yet not taking his life.
